# ColumnAlign

`Flare.Components.ColumnAlign`

Horizontal text alignment of a column's header and cells. Values are logical (writing-direction aware), so End is the right edge in LTR and the left edge in RTL.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Start` | `0` | Leading edge (left in LTR). The default for text. |
| `Center` | `1` | Centered. The default for booleans. |
| `End` | `2` | Trailing edge (right in LTR). The default for numbers. |

## Used by components

- `FlareColumn`
